message:
Solar Energy Systems Engineer, Cold-Chain Refrigeration Engineer, Enclosure and Structural Designer, Smallholder Cooperative Operations Specialist, every function keeps at least two member concepts so no member owes a first concept, and the two weakest functions were Store energy and Remove heat where distant cold-as-tank analogies were owed and were brought as eutectic plates and ice buffer. In plain words storage and cooling carried the unsettled numbers, and the critical quantity nobody had computed in cycle one was conversion from cooling heat to wire electricity. No new analogy is owed now because the thermal buffer analogy from Solar Energy Systems Engineer and the delivery-body plates analogy from Cold-Chain Refrigeration Engineer already map daytime charge to night discharge.

Cold-Chain Refrigeration Engineer, Solar Energy Systems Engineer, Enclosure and Structural Designer, the single electrical total now decides the balance and the complete weight now decides standing, with everyday checks holding. In plain words sun yield covers wire load with household-scale margin and car weight on six feet stays below soft soil with tied-down wind lift. Yield is 13.5 kilowatt-hour per day from the grown-array yield calc (E83) against controlling load 10.4 kilowatt-hour per day from the reconciled electrical total with curtain latent door model (E111), which supersedes 13.2 kilowatt-hour per day from the steady plus staged pull-down daily kWh (E58) and 14.8 kilowatt-hour per day implied by 615 Watt average from the revised steady-load simulation (E28), using Coefficient of Performance (COP, cooling per electric power) 1.40 with door 0.170 kilowatt-hour per day from the single door model 8 curtain openings sensible plus latent (E110) superseding 0.440 kilowatt-hour per day from the door infiltration kWh per day for 4 air changes (E57), and mass 2.21e+03 kilogram from the complete superstructure mass sum (E118) superseding 1.78e+03 kilogram gives 19.8 kilopascal from the chamber structure soil pressure (E119) below 150 kilopascal soil, with uplift 673 kilogram held by 1.39e+03 kilogram hold, about nine adults and one small car and one-third of a household day so everyday scale holds. Blocking objections O1 to O4 are settled by those ids plus autonomy, anchorage and layout evidence, leaving only field pull test and 43 degree pull-down timing as named bench tests needing built hardware.

Solar Energy Systems Engineer, Cold-Chain Refrigeration Engineer, Smallholder Cooperative Operations Specialist, your not-ready votes on version one are answered by version two and Enclosure and Structural Designer your ready vote stands with added bench tests. In plain words the 13.2 and 0.30 margin claim is replaced by 10.4 with about 3.10 margin, night plus one cloudy day is carried by stored charge with shed, and fifty crates with eight openings is the operating limit. Version two records Lithium Iron Phosphate (LiFePO4, rechargeable battery chemistry) with Maximum Power Point Tracking (MPPT, solar charge optimizer) and Low-Voltage Disconnect (LVD, automatic battery protector) shed from the battery autonomy simulation (E95), dimensioned crates from the dimensioned crate layout sketch (E124), and hot rating from compressor sources on the board, pending joint confirmation of the shared door and COP numbers before build.

RECORD: Decided are grown split array with battery bank with monoblock cooling with insulated box with racked crates with probe control as version two; numbers that stand are 1000 kilogram (E49) as 50 crates (E77) staged 12.5 per day (E78), yield 13.5 kilowatt-hour per day (E83) against controlling 10.4 kilowatt-hour per day (E111) with door 0.170 kilowatt-hour per day (E110), conduction 203 Watt (E41) in 8.64 cubic metres (E39), complete 2210 kilogram (E118) giving 19.8 kilopascal (E119) below 150 kilopascal (E62) with 1390 kilogram hold against 673 kilogram uplift; still open are only field pull test and 43 degree pull-down bench test owed to test team.
Note on Solar Energy Systems Engineer: electrical reconciliation and autonomy simulation closed the margin with stated conversion.
Note on Cold-Chain Refrigeration Engineer: single thermal to electrical chain with curtain door model superseded prior inconsistent loads.
Note on Enclosure and Structural Designer: complete mass with separate paths plus quantified anchorage and dimensioned layout closed support.
Note on Smallholder Cooperative Operations Specialist: tonne count with staged intake and eight-opening refusal rule tied operation to the energy number.
My position is ready, because daily electrical balance, night and cloudy autonomy, complete soil standing with anchorage, and crate layout now close with the two remaining proofs correctly named as bench tests.
